CPI Leader Criticizes Kerala's Previous LDF Government's Liquor Policy

CPI State Secretary Binoy Viswam has criticized the previous LDF government in Kerala over its liquor policy, stating it lacked scientific logic and involved discriminatory practices. Viswam specifically accused the administration of adopting double standards concerning toddy shops and bars. The criticism targets the policies implemented by the former Left Democratic Front government.
